recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Follow up through UTG/THO to update CodeSystem-v3-CodeSystem code AddressUse to the approved VSAC wording, and regenerate or correct downstream THO or extension-pack surfaces that repeat the stale text from that terminology source.
issue_request: The Published DSTU1 FHIR-core/vocab issue asked to replace the v3 CodeSystem AddressUse placeholder text "Uses of Addresses. Lloyd to supply more complete description" with a complete definition; the final Persuasive with Modification resolution directed MnM to create a harmonization proposal using the VSAC definition "The purpose for which a location is assigned the associated postal address".
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-7269 commit was found in current core history. The old wording remains in the copied 2019 v3 MIF data at tools/tx/v3/source.xml for both v3-CodeSystem AddressUse and the v3-AddressUse CONF concept, but that copied artifact was added after UTG content had been removed from the active core build.
additional_context: The 2020 UTG migration removed the in-core v2/v3 terminology tabs and rewired v3 code-system references to terminology.hl7.org. Current terminology source pages direct code-system discovery to THO and exclude HL7 Terminology value sets outside core. Current build URLs for the old v3 CodeSystem pages return 404, while the current THO CodeSystem-v3-CodeSystem JSON still contains the stale AddressUse definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No HL7/fhir source was changed because editing the copied MIF file would not be an authoritative current-spec fix and would not safely update the THO artifact that now owns v3 CodeSystem content.
